title: `Owned.transferOwnership` Allows Permanent Ownership Lockout (Zero Address)
impact: Calling `transferOwnership(address(0))` irreversibly sets `owner` to zero. Since `onlyOwner` checks `msg.sender == owner` and no address can be `address(0)`, **every owner-gated function becomes permanently uncallable**. If the contract controls funds, upgrades, or minting, those capabilities are destroyed. There is no recovery path.
